card.name: Spaces and separators inside calendar dates
card.fires_on: The separator or small word right after a month or day in a written date or timestamp, such as the space after "Nov" or the dash in "25-Mar". It also fires on time-zone codes and on weekday names after "Date:".

modes.label: Gap after month or day
modes.description: A space, period or comma right after an abbreviated month or day number, just before the next number.

modes.label: Timestamp pieces
modes.description: Time-zone codes or dashes inside machine-style date stamps.

modes.label: Date label
modes.description: A weekday following a "Date:" label in an event listing.

card.writes: It suppresses the word "date" and its variants, so the model is less likely to write that word, and it favors a number or other continuation.
card.plain: It fires in the middle of a written calendar date, where the next piece is a day or year number rather than the word date.
